title: sieve_delivery Keep: two queries per delivery, could be one
description:
In sieve_delivery() (smtp/src/session.rs, Keep arm), JMAP delivery does two sequential queries:

  1. SELECT id FROM users WHERE username=?
  2. SELECT mailbox_id FROM user_mailboxes WHERE user_id=? AND role='inbox'

These can be combined into a single JOIN:

  SELECT u.id, m.mailbox_id
  FROM users u
  JOIN user_mailboxes m ON m.user_id=u.id AND m.role='inbox'
  WHERE u.username=?

This halves the SQLite round-trips on the per-message delivery hot path. At low volume the difference is negligible; at high inbound message rates (burst MX delivery) it reduces lock contention on the mail SQLite database.
